comparison.objective: Select weights whose total makes a scale read exactly 300 g.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual label interpretation, arithmetic selection, and pick-and-place onto a pan.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly 300 g resting on the pan earns full credit; 200 or 400 g earns partial credit.
comparison.reason: This tests selection and arithmetic rather than adjustment, torque, locking, or dynamic response.
